workstream: B06 OpenSSH Client LocalSource guarded lifecycle

behavior: Read the target's HKLM Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Servicing\LocalSourcePath before CAB metadata inspection, snapshot creation, or servicing.
Refuse LocalSource servicing when the policy value is nonempty.
Fail closed when the policy key or value cannot be inspected.
Persist the fallback inspection result in the run snapshot and return it in transition results.
Repeat the policy guard when validating a saved LocalSource for restore.

B06 Telnet LocalSource validation remains unimplemented and blocked on target-specific package identity and matching media.
